abstract: Forty-six female Sprague-Dawley rats were used. Twelve days after mating, all the fetuses were removed and fetal membrane with yolk sac were left outside of the uterus following the method reported by Sorbis and Vandeputte (1974). About the half of the rats were ovariectomized at the laparotomy. The rats were killed at 20 and 40 weeks after treatment and examined. No difference was observed in tumor incidence between fetectomy alone and fetectomy plus ovariectomy at both 20 and 40 weeks and it was about 70%. The size of tumor varied from 2 to 35 mm in diameter. The size of tumors tended to be greater in fetectomy plus ovariectomy compared with fetectomy alone at 20 weeks, but no significant difference was observed at 40 weeks between the two groups. Histologically the tumors were characterized by the presence of a variety of differentiated tissues. Metastases to the visceral part were detected in 2 rats of fetectomy alone and the tumors were diagnosed as yolk sac tumor. These results indicate that sex steroids might influence the teratocarcinogenesis.
abstract_ja: 雌のSprague-Dawleyラット46匹を用いた。交配12日後に全胎仔を摘出し、Sorbis および Vandeputte(1974)の方法に従い、卵黄嚢を伴う胎児膜を子宮外に残置した。約半数のラットは開腹時に卵巣摘出を行った。治療後20週および40週で屠殺し、検査を行った。胎仔摘出単独群と胎仔摘出+卵巣摘出群の間で、20週および40週のいずれにおいても腫瘍発生率に差は認められず、約70%であった。腫瘍の大きさは直径2〜35 mmであった。20週時点では、胎仔摘出単独群と比べて胎仔摘出+卵巣摘出群で腫瘍が大きい傾向が見られたが、40週では両群間に有意な差は認められなかった。組織学的には、腫瘍は多様な分化組織の存在を特徴としていた。胎仔摘出単独群の2匹に内臓への転移が認められ、その腫瘍は卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。これらの結果は、性ステロイドが奇形癌発生に影響を及ぼす可能性を示唆している。
